summary: Food service with a guest dining area and a kitchen. Variants: full cooking kitchen (storkök) and café with simple preparation. The dining area is a 'serveringsutrymme i restaurang' in verksamhetsklass 2A (≤150 persons) or 2B (>150), or 2C for large pubs/nightclubs serving alcohol beyond a limited extent. A full kitchen triggers the heaviest building demands: grease-laden exhaust duct with fire rating (EI 60/EI 30) taken to an outlet that does not disturb neighbours, possible separate fire cell, grease separator under municipal VA rules, floor drainage, and hygiene layout under EU 852/2004. National law requires no customer WC and, since 1 June 2026, the alcohol licence no longer requires a kitchen or seats.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass: Dining area 2A (≤150 persons) / 2B (>150) per BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 11–12 §§ ('serveringsutrymmen i restauranger'); 2C (13 §) for >150 persons where alcohol is served beyond a limited extent (larger pubs, nightclubs). Kitchen and staff areas vk 1. See cross_cutting.json fire_vk_2abc.

BFS 2024:8 hygien, hälsa och miljö (8 kap. 15 §, 9 kap. 1 §, 11 kap.)

permits: Bygglov for change of use from office (PBL 9 kap. 15 § 1, cross_cutting.json cou_bygglov_trigger). Detaljplan: a restaurant as main purpose fits Centrum (C), not Detaljhandel (H) — Boverket kunskapsbanken 'Detaljhandel'; old H/K plans may exclude restaurants.
Anmälan (PBF 6 kap. 1 §) for ventilation, VA, fire protection and structural openings (exhaust shaft).
Registration of livsmedelsanläggning (LIVSFS 2022:8 2 §); may start on registration or two weeks after notification (9 §).

Serveringstillstånd from the municipality if alcohol is served: defined serving area (Alkohollag 8 kap. 14 §), premises suitable from fire-safety viewpoint (8 kap. 16 §). Kitchen, food and seat requirements abolished from 2026-06-01.
Municipal VA: grease separator installation and notification per local rules.
Outdoor seating on public land: police permit (ordningslagen) — not verified here.
regulatory.operator_oversight: Kommunal livsmedelskontroll; kommunal alkoholhandläggning (tillstånd); räddningstjänsten; byggnadsnämnd; VA-huvudman; Arbetsmiljöverket

gross_m2_per_unit.source: No Swedish public source found for m2 per restaurant seat (dining or gross). Old BBR general advice (table 5:333, repealed) used number of seats or 1.0 person/m2 net for restaurants as egress design load — not a space standard.

egress_design_density.source: BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 4 §: design number = maximum expected persons (furnished seats + standing + staff). Default densities exist only for affärslokal 0.5, pub/bar 3.0 and samlingslokal 2.5 persons/m2; restaurants are not listed. Old BBR advice: seats or 1.0/m2 (cross_cutting.json occ_density_bbr_table_5333, practice for new applications). A bar-type café would fall under pub/bar 3.0/m2.

occupancy.hourly_presence_note: Modelling assumption (indicative, not sourced): full-service restaurant with lunch peak 12 and dinner peak 18–20; share of seats occupied. Café variant: see variants.

required.basis: Defining space. No national seat or size requirement (alcohol-licence seat requirement abolished 2026-06-01). If alcohol is served the licensed area must be defined (Alkohollag 8 kap. 14 §).

size.source: No Swedish public source for m2 per seat.

spaces.shareable_note: Lunch restaurant can double as staff eating place for office tenants (AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 60 § allmänna råd names restaurants as suitable eating places); evening events.
spaces.notes: >150 persons → 2B: fire alarm, evacuation alarm, emergency lighting, two exits with the alternative exit leading to the main entrance or equivalent; with alcohol beyond limited extent → 2C with 15 m travel distance (cross_cutting.json fire_vk_2abc). In 2A a single exit is acceptable only for ≤30 persons with a door to safe place (BFS 2024:7 7 kap. 11 §). Facade_required reflects practice (street visibility), not law. Guest ventilation: no national l/s per guest found for restaurants (staff: AFS 2023:12 5 kap. 4 §).

required.basis: Food preparation rooms must meet EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. II (design and layout permitting good hygiene, protection against contamination; facilities for cleaning/disinfecting tools; food-washing facilities where necessary) and ch. I (ventilation, drainage, lighting). Fire: storkök surfaces B-s1,d0 ceiling / C-s2,d0 wall (BFS 2024:7 5 kap. 17 §); storkök with particular fire risk = own fire cell unless an automatic extinguishing system limits the risk (5 kap. 26 §).

size.source: No Swedish public source for kitchen m2 per seat; 852/2004 is functional.

spaces.notes: Kitchen staff are at permanent workplaces: daylight/view per AFS 2023:12 5 kap. 25 § or compensating measures (cross_cutting.json staff_room_height_daylight). Floor drains not a food-law requirement (kontrollwiki art. 343) but standard in cooking kitchens; BFS 2024:8 7 kap. 7–11 §§ require watertight layers and floor drains where floors are often exposed to water.

required.basis: BFS 2024:7 4 kap. 23 §: imkanaler serving storkök at least EI 60 in byggnadsklass 1, EI 30 in byggnadsklass 2–3 (non-insulated parts allowed inside the served room with 0.10 m clearance, outdoors with 0.5 m); 24 §: storkök ducts with large combustible deposits need assured fire resistance inside the duct unless a deposit-limiting system is fitted; 5 kap. 20 §: imkanaler and hoods in storkök of non-combustible material; 4 kap. 22 §: household-type cooking (café) EI 15 or E 15. BFS 2024:8 9 kap. 1 §: exhaust outlets placed so pollutants/odours are not drawn back and no nuisance arises in the surroundings.

size.count: vertical shaft through all floors above, plus fan space

spaces.notes: Outlet above roof is the usual way to meet BFS 2024:8 9 kap. 1 § and avoid odour nuisance (miljöbalken tillsyn); Danish municipal rules (e.g. Gentofte, Copenhagen) explicitly require outlet above the ridge — no equivalent Swedish national rule found, so 'via roof' is practice. Typically the single most decisive feature of an office building for a full restaurant.

required.basis: Municipal VA rules. MittSverige Vatten & Avfall (Sundsvall): restaurants, cafés, bakeries, staff canteens etc. must have a grease separator meeting SS-EN 1825-1/-2, reported to the VA utility; exemption possible for small/packaged-only businesses. Kristinehamn similarly lists cafés and restaurants. BFS 2024:8 8 kap. 15 §: WC wastewater may not be connected to grease separators.

spaces.notes: Municipal guides commonly require alarm and sampling point, no placement in food rooms, and emptying several times per year by suction truck — so vehicle access within hose reach matters. Kitchen-only drainage must be separated from WC stacks.

required.basis: EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. II p. 2: adequate facilities, where necessary, for cleaning, disinfecting and storage of working utensils and equipment, with hot and cold water. AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 7 § allmänna råd names dishwashers as equipment that may need a separate room.

spaces.notes: Kontrollwiki (search excerpt): dirty dishes and outer packaging should not pass through areas where unpackaged food is handled.

required.basis: Needed to keep the cold chain; no room-level requirement found.

EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. I p. 4 (adequate number, suitably located, hot and cold water, hygienic drying); kontrollwiki art. 1045 (separate from food-rinsing where necessary; must not be blocked by food/dishes).

size.count: in kitchen near each food-handling station and at staff WCs

spaces.label_en: Staff WC, changing room and shower

required.basis: EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. I p. 3 (lavatories not opening directly into food-handling rooms) and p. 9 (changing facilities where necessary); AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 46 § changing room when special work clothes are worn, 48 § normally separate for men/women if used simultaneously, 51 § shower normally if work is sweaty or dirty. Kontrollwiki art. 1045: food-law WC requirement concerns staff WCs; an antechamber may be needed if the WC is close to unprotected food.

size.count: 1 WC per started 15 employees (AFS allmänna råd to 3 kap. 56 §)
size.source: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 58 § allmänna råd: accessible WC ≥2.2 x 2.2 m. Changing room/shower: no size.

spaces.shareable_note: Kontrollwiki: a single WC may be shared with customers only if the operator can show routines preventing contamination.
spaces.notes: Staff route to changing should not pass areas with unpackaged food (kontrollwiki excerpt).

required.basis: Not required by national law: Livsmedelsverket kontrollwiki art. 1045 says customer toilets are the operator's decision; Boverket only requires that one is accessible if public WCs exist (BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 7 §; cross_cutting.json san_public, access_public_premises_wc).

spaces.notes: In practice every seated restaurant provides guest WCs, and municipal alcohol or local rules may expect them.

spaces.shareable_note: Staff may eat in the dining room outside service if conditions are satisfactory (60 § allmänna råd).

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 32 § goods reception when needed; 11 § doors can be held open for deliveries. Hygiene: deliveries/outer packaging should not cross unpackaged-food areas (kontrollwiki).

spaces.label_en: Waste room incl. food waste and used cooking oil

required.basis: EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. VI (removal, closable containers, adequate storage, pest-free); BFS 2024:8 11 kap. 1–3 §§. MSVA: frying oil and large amounts of fat collected separately, not to the grease separator.

size.source: Kontrollwiki art. 343: food law cannot require a cooled waste room only because of odour.

variants.label: Restaurant with full cooking kitchen (storkök)
variants.changes: Imkanal EI 60 (Br1) / EI 30 (Br2–3) to outlet, non-combustible hood/duct, deposit control (BFS 2024:7 4 kap. 23–24 §§, 5 kap. 20 §); own fire cell if particular fire risk unless automatic extinguishing (5 kap. 26 §); grease separator; floor drains; changing rooms and showers for kitchen staff.

variants.label: Café with simple preparation
variants.changes: Household-type cooking only: imkanal EI 15 or E 15 (BFS 2024:7 4 kap. 22 §); no storkök fire cell; grease separator still often required by municipal VA rules (MSVA lists cafés); hours closer to retail (≈7–18, peaks 8, 12, 15); hourly_presence e.g. [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0.3,0.6,0.4,0.4,0.6,0.9,0.6,0.4,0.6,0.4,0.2,0.05,0,0,0,0,0] (indicative).

variants.label: Bar / nightclub >150 persons with alcohol (2C)
variants.changes: 15 m travel distance, spoken evacuation alarm, pub/bar default 3 persons/m2 (cross_cutting.json); serveringstillstånd; no kitchen needed since 2026-06-01.

typical_blockers: No vertical shaft route for a fire-rated kitchen exhaust to roof through upper floors (often other tenants).
No kitchen drainage/grease-separator route and floor drains in office slabs; suction-truck access for emptying.
Detaljplan K or old H may exclude restaurants; needs C or plan change.
Change from vk 1 to 2A/2B/2C: 30 m (15 m) travel, exit count not relaxable for 2B/2C at change of use (cross_cutting.json fire_change_of_use_floor).
Odour and noise nuisance to office or residential neighbours (fans, deliveries, late hours).
typical_enablers: Ground floor with street frontage and existing shafts.
Café variant with simple preparation avoids most kitchen exhaust and fire-cell demands.
Office tenants above provide lunch demand.

open_questions: No Swedish public source for m2 per seat (dining, kitchen, gross). Need operator data (e.g. Visita) or municipal school/elderly-care kitchen programmes as proxies.
Restaurant dining is not among the BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 4 § default densities; confirm with a fire consultant whether to use furnished seats, samlingslokal 2.5/m2 or old BBR 1.0/m2.
Kitchen exhaust 'via roof': no Swedish national rule found; check municipal miljöförvaltning guidance (e.g. Stockholm, Göteborg) and Boverket guidance to BFS 2024:8 9 kap. 1 §.
Outdoor air for guests in restaurants: FoHMFS 2014:18 (lokaler för allmänna ändamål) not checked for restaurant values.
Stockholm Vatten och Avfall's grease-separator page could not be retrieved; thresholds (e.g. meals per day) differ by municipality.
'Storkök med särskild brandrisk' (BFS 2024:7 5 kap. 26 §) — definition and threshold not read; check Boverket guidance.
BFS 2025:10 amendments to BFS 2024:7 (from 2025-12-01) not checked.
Alkohollag 8 kap. 15 § repeal read on riksdagen.se and municipal pages (Köping, Malmö); confirm SFS 2026:511 text.
